title: Camp trail snack, one rule
storyboard: Film: overhead of kids mixing trail snack in steel tins at camp; guide sealing pouches before the walk (2 shots)

scenes.headline: Our trail-snack recipe has one secret rule
Peanuts, jaggery, puffed rice, raisins
scenes.body: Mix in a steel tin. Pack in a sealed pouch.

scenes.headline: Fed monkeys ate less wild fruit
scenes.body: In Buxa Tiger Reserve, a macaque troop ate less fruit and spread fewer seeds while being fed by people.

caption:
The secret ingredient is self-control.

In the same study, fed macaques also moved shorter distances each day and dropped seeds on roads, where they rarely grow.

Source: Sengupta, McConkey & Radhakrishna 2015, PLoS ONE. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Food-recipe format as a camp trail-snack with a sourced conservation twist (don't feed wildlife); kitchen shots storyboarded.
